name: Charge a phone
summary: Phones charge from 5V USB, and a car USB charger turns any 12V battery into exactly that. Lots of cars have one in the glove box or cup holder. A small solar panel and a step-down converter charge a phone in a few hours of sun. Dead vapes and laptop packs hold cells that rebuild into power banks.

parts.why: Turns 12V into 5V USB; car chargers are ready-made ones
Charges directly, or fills a battery
Power banks, or cells to build one
One car battery charges dozens of phones
Single-cell charger boards (TP4056) for homemade power banks
Steps a single 3.7V cell up to 5V
Hand-crank power when there’s no sun

tips: Car USB chargers run on 12–24V. Wire one to any 12V battery through a small fuse.
Airplane mode and low brightness stretch one charge over days.
A 5–10W panel in full sun charges a phone in about 2–4 hours. Cloud slows it a lot.
Charge in the shade: hot phones charge slowly or stop.
